reason: The diagnosis is correct. The exp60 ins35* arms use the kernel's 5-fold DaughterNet v1 ensemble p (score_nodes has no model_index), and v1 was trained on all 199 train videos, so every lab clip was seen by 4 of the 5 models. But an honest OOF arm cannot change any decision. (1) Insertion is already decided by the LB under R2: #35 0.954 >= #34 0.953, so branch A. T9's insertion check only writes a WARNING ('R2 unchanged, LB decides'), and T9 already discounts arcs that lean on network confidence to 0. (2) nosteal0 is blocked by the rules whatever the lab says. R2 allows only the #35 config (no ladders), and R4 needs a fork-set changer to gain >= +0.002 on the LB, never accepting a lab gain alone. (3) The lab has no statistical power here. #35 made 12 forks with 5 steals on 4 dummy clips, and exp48 CONFIRMATION had 466 insertions, 124 steals and only 15 evaluable added forks (~3%). So the 56 lab clips (99 GT divisions) hold ~50 steals and ~1-2 evaluable ones, and only some of those come from edge_prob-0.0 edges. The '+2 net evaluable TP' gate is effectively unreachable, so the result is 'close nosteal0' with or without OOF. (4) Metric ceiling: with J_pub ~0.36, one public division event is ~0.001. On the hidden set nosteal0 touches ~4 evaluable steals (~1-2 public), under R4's +0.002 bar, so the value of perfect information is ~0. (5) OOF single-fold p is not the deployed signal either: the 5-fold ensemble on unseen embryos differs, the 0.5<->0.4 threshold map is an eligible-count calibration on exp39 SELECTION, and reporting both is a small threshold ladder fitted to noise. The cost is 0.3-0.5 GPU-h from the ~9 h weekly quota that exp60 shard B and the K3/K3b dummies need, plus 1.5-2 agent-hours in the R10 crunch.
fix: Keep the honesty point without the compute. (a) Label ins35 / ins35_nosteal0 / ins35_forkmid45 as 'IN-SAMPLE UPPER BOUND (4/5 DaughterNet folds saw these clips)' in the trainlab results md and in CONTEXT before T9 reads them (~5 min). (b) Pre-register now: nosteal0 is CLOSED under R2 ('only the #35 config'), and no lab result reopens it. (c) Keep the T9 insertion check as a warning only; its failure is informative, its pass is not. (d) Only if GPU quota is idle after K3/K3b dummies and shard B, run the OOF rescore as a pure diagnostic, with no decision attached.
realistic_gain: 0 on public and private LB. It moves no decision, because R2/R4/T9 already neutralize in-sample insertion arms. The guard value of +0.0001..0.0003 claimed in the idea needs a nosteal0 adoption that the rules already forbid. Net value is slightly negative: 0.3-0.5 GPU-h and 1.5-2 agent-hours in the crunch.
